description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): revoke and delete a share with DELETE /api/v1/shares/:id. Connect writes website.share.revoked, closes the edge route and tunnel within its 5-second revocation budget and keeps the audit trail; a public hostname returns 410, not a cached page. Deleting a node in Network closes every share for that node through network.link.revoked.
